text: Ninety-three lessons in total, and this entire course genuinely ends the exact same way a real professional project ends: actually presenting the finished work to someone.

Spend the first thirty seconds entirely on the dashboard's three pinned tiles before anything else. Follow one tile into its full report page only once someone in the room actually asks why. Show the drillthrough detail only if someone specifically requests territory-level information — never simply by default.

Check the entire finished project directly against Lesson 84's original written scope, one single requirement at a time, methodically. Every single row on that list genuinely needs a clear answer sitting somewhere in the finished dashboard.

The real test that actually matters here is the exact same one Chapter Eight taught you all the way back near the beginning: hand this finished dashboard to someone genuinely unfamiliar with the underlying data, and see whether they can name the single most important number on the page in under ten seconds flat.

From a simple opening question of what is Power BI, all the way to a fully secured, properly scheduled, genuinely published dashboard — that complete arc is really the entire job of a working Power BI developer. Course complete. Congratulations on finishing all ninety-three lessons.
